aiResearchSummary.text: Prime Lightworks is engaged in research and development of electromagnetic energy momentum thrusters, as described in the title 'Electromagnetic Energy Momentum Thruster Using Tapered Cavity Resonator.' The abstract details a system with a cavity resonator and an electromagnetic radiation source that emits waves to generate enhanced electromagnetic field amplitudes, aligning with the company's focus on electric propulsion systems for space satellites. This highlights their work in advanced propulsion technologies.
